entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say or enter your customer ID number.
Thank you. Connecting you to an agent now.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit support. I see you're calling about your VeloBand Cadence Sensor. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference matter?
It's fine. I just changed my mind.
Okay, I understand. So you're just not finding it as useful as you'd hoped?
Basically. It was an impulse buy and I just don't use it. So, can I return it or not?
Let me just pull up your order details and our policy. One moment. ... Okay, I see the band was delivered to you on December 15th, which was 23 days ago.
Great. So you know when I got it.
Yes, and according to our VeloFit return policy, you have 90 days from the date of delivery to return an item. So you are well within the window for a full refund.
Oh. I thought it would be a bigger deal. Fine.

Not at all, we want you to be happy with your gear. And I see here you're a VIP member with us, so I've gone ahead and waived the return shipping fee for you. I've just emailed you a prepaid shipping label.
Whatever. I have the email. So I just print it and send it back?

That's correct. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's it. Thanks, I guess.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
